title Laboratorio - the fossil lab: a curious, techy sequencer in C that shifts its notes like a machine thinking (four against three), bleeps, a hat and a kick, and a question mark of a tune that never lands (125 bpm)
tempo 125
vol 220
meter 4/4
inst seq v=255,210,160,120
inst lead v=255,255,225,195,180
inst blip v=255,0
inst kick drum=g5 v=255,200,140 d=0,-45,-75
inst hat drum=c8 v=110,60
l16
# --- 1-4: the sequencer, four notes a beat (Cmaj7, Am, F, G)
@seq o4 [ c e g >c< ]4 |
@seq o4 [ a >c e c< ]4 |
@seq o4 [ f a >c a< ]4 |
@seq o4 [ g b >d b< ]4 |
# --- 5-8: the phasing: three notes against the bar of four, so the pattern shifts
@seq o4 [ c e g ]5 c |
@seq o4 [ a >c e< ]5 a |
@seq o4 [ f a >c< ]5 f |
@seq o4 [ g b >d< ]5 g |
# --- 9-12: the question-mark tune, a hat and a kick
@lead o5 !kick:c8 e8 !hat:g8 e8 >c4< g4 |
@lead o5 !kick:a8 >c8< !hat:e8 c8 a4 e4 |
@lead o5 !kick:f8 a8 >!hat:c8< a8 f4 >c4< |
@lead o5 !kick:g8 b8 >!hat:d8 f8< g4 r4 |
# --- 13-14: the data burst (blips) and the machine ticks on
@blip o6 [ g16 g16 r16 ]5 r16 |
@blip o5 [ !hat=6 c16 ]16 |
